WITH customer_order_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    c.gender,
    COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count
  FROM Customers c
  LEFT JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE c.gender IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.gender
),
gender_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    c.gender,
    COUNT(o.order_id) as total_gender_orders
  FROM Customers c
  LEFT JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE c.gender IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.gender
),
customer_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    coc.customer_id,
    coc.gender,
    coc.order_count,
    coc.order_count * 1.0 / gt.total_gender_orders as share
  FROM customer_order_counts coc
  JOIN gender_totals gt ON coc.gender = gt.gender
),
avg_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share_value
  FROM customer_shares
)
SELECT 
  cs.customer_id,
  cs.gender,
  cs.order_count,
  cs.share,
  cs.share - asc.avg_share_value as gap_above_average
FROM customer_shares cs
CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc asc
WHERE cs.share > asc.avg_share_value
ORDER BY gap_above_average IS NULL ASC, gap_above_average DESC
LIMIT 10
